morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆。派生 menyengsarakan 时，meN- 在词首 s 前实现为 meny-，原来的 s 脱落：meN- + sengsara + -kan → menyengsarakan；ng 表示 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 苦难；由艰难处境、匮乏或折磨造成的痛苦。
senses.nuances: 指所承受的苦楚，通常比一般的不便或麻烦更重。名词用法见 menanggung sengsara；表示苦难状态时也常用派生名词 kesengsaraan。词义依据：[DBP PRPM：sengsara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sengsara)。

senses.zh_definition: 处境困苦的；遭受痛苦或折磨的。
senses.en_definition: Afflicted by suffering or hardship; miserable.
senses.nuances: 描述人的生活或身心状态。口语中可用于夸张抱怨，但用于他人的贫困、疾病或灾难经历时，应避免轻佻语气。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 社会援助汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Keluarga yang hidup sengsara akibat kehilangan sumber pendapatan akan diberikan bantuan segera.
dual_scenarios.zh: 因失去收入来源而生活困苦的家庭将获得紧急援助。
dual_scenarios.en: Families living in hardship after losing their source of income will receive immediate assistance.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 向朋友诉说生活压力
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sejak hilang kerja, hidup aku sengsara, nak bayar sewa pun susah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sejak kehilangan pekerjaan, hidup saya sengsara sehingga sukar untuk membayar sewa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 失业之后，我日子过得很苦，连房租都快交不起了。
dual_scenarios.en: Life's been really hard since I lost my job. I'm struggling even to pay the rent.
spoken_features: hilang kerja：口语表达，对应 kehilangan pekerjaan

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sejak hilang kerja, hidup aku sengsara. Nak bayar sewa pun susah.
messages.ms_standard: Sejak kehilangan pekerjaan, hidup saya sengsara. Saya sukar untuk membayar sewa sekalipun.
messages.zh: 失业之后，我日子过得很苦，连房租都难交。
messages.en: Life's been really hard since I lost my job. I can barely pay the rent.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah mohon bantuan belum? Kalau nak, aku boleh tolong semak borang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah memohon bantuan? Jika awak mahu, saya boleh membantu menyemak borang.
messages.zh: 你申请援助了吗？需要的话，我可以帮你看看表格。
messages.en: Have you applied for assistance yet? I can help you check the form if you'd like.

etymology.historical_story: Sengsara comes from Sanskrit saṃsāra, associated with worldly existence and the cycle of rebirth. In Malay, the inherited cultural association with suffering became an everyday meaning: misery and hardship. Modern speakers can use the word without invoking a religious doctrine. This makes it a useful example of an older philosophical term acquiring a general emotional meaning. Reference: [IIUM discussion of sengsara and saṃsāra](https://centre.iium.edu.my/centris/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/10/MKH_SEJAHTERA-FALAH-TRULY-FINAL-6July2020.docx-1.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seng-sa-ra 联想成“生活苦，三声叹”：苦难接连而来，就是 sengsara。此为记忆联想，并非词源拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身没有冒犯性。谈论他人的遭遇时，宜描述具体困境并表达关怀，避免当面给人贴上 orang sengsara 的标签。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述严重生活压力、受虐或灾难造成的痛苦。朋友之间可夸张自嘲；面对正在受苦的人，应避免把轻微不便说得同样严重。
